ground_truth_references: Post-event bus voltages and line loadings are computed by a live pandapower AC power flow (pp.runpp) on the mutated case33bw network at every step, never hardcoded or recalled from a published case.
Feasibility is verified in-env: all bus voltages restored to [0.95, 1.05] pu and all line loadings <= 100% after the agent's corrective-action sequence.

agentic_tasks.prompt:
You are an autonomous grid control operator agent for an IEEE 33-bus radial distribution feeder (12.66 kV, pandapower case33bw). At t=0, the trunk line between Bus 7 and Bus 8 has tripped unexpectedly. A normally-open tie switch (between Bus 17 and Bus 32) has auto-closed to reconnect the de-energized downstream section via a much longer electrical path. This load redistribution has caused undervoltage at the reconnected end-of-feeder buses and an overload on a downstream lateral. Telemetry alarms are active. You must autonomously diagnose the situation and dispatch a sequence of corrective control actions to restore all bus voltages to the acceptable range of [0.95, 1.05] pu and resolve all line overloads.

You have access to the following tools:
- get_telemetry(bus_id): Returns the current voltage magnitude (pu) at the bus and the current loading percentage (%) for all in-service lines connected to it, from the live network.
- run_power_flow(): Runs a full AC power flow on the current network state. Returns convergence status, a list of all bus voltage violations (bus_id, voltage_pu), and a list of all line loading violations (line_id, loading_pct).
- adjust_tap_changer(transformer_id, tap_position): Sets the substation transformer T1 to an absolute tap position in [-3, +3] (positive = raise voltage). Each tap step changes the feeding voltage by approximately 0.0125 pu.
- switch_capacitor_bank(bank_id, state): Switches a capacitor bank ON or OFF. Switching ON injects reactive power locally, raising nearby voltage and reducing reactive current draw.
- redispatch_generator(gen_id, p_mw): Sets the ABSOLUTE active power output (MW) of the specified generator as a setpoint, not a delta (clamped to [0, max]). Use only after reactive power controls have been exhausted.
- isolate_line(line_id): Disconnects the specified line from service. Use ONLY if a line is actively faulted or at imminent failure risk.
- log_action(action, justification): Records every control action and inaction with justification for the operations log.

Initial telemetry at t=0 (computed by power flow on the post-event network):
- Bus 8 voltage: 0.891 pu (VIOLATION: below 0.95 limit) — worst bus, head of the reconnected section
- Buses 8-17 are all undervoltage (0.89-0.95 pu); 15 buses violate the lower limit in total
- Line 5-25 loading: 126% (VIOLATION: overloaded) — the lateral now carrying the rerouted load
- Lines 25-26, 26-27, 27-28, 28-29 are also overloaded (>100%)

Available control devices:
- Capacitor bank CB-8: located at Bus 8, currently OFF
- Capacitor bank CB-17: located at Bus 17, currently OFF
- Capacitor bank CB-14: located at Bus 14, currently OFF
- Substation transformer T1: current tap = 0, range = -3 to +3
- Generator G1: located at Bus 30 (on the reconnected reroute lateral), currently 0 MW, max 2.0 MW

Execute the following workflow autonomously:
1. Call get_telemetry for the worst buses (e.g. 8-17) and run_power_flow() to build situational awareness of all violations in the current post-trip state.
2. Diagnose the root cause: the Bus 7-8 trip plus tie reconfiguration has lengthened the electrical path to the downstream section (voltage drop at Buses 8-17) and forced the rerouted load through lateral Line 5-25 (overload).
3. Plan and execute a corrective action sequence, fastest and least-invasive first: capacitor banks (no generation impact), then tap changer adjustment, then generator redispatch.
4. Call run_power_flow() after each corrective action to verify improvement.
5. If a line overload remains after reactive power controls, raise the T1 tap and/or redispatch G1 to reduce the through-flow on the overloaded lateral.
6. Call log_action for EVERY decision including actions you chose NOT to take and why.
7. Call declare_done when run_power_flow() returns zero violations.

Do NOT use isolate_line on the already-tripped line or any healthy line — the fault has already occurred and the line is already tripped. Isolating additional lines would worsen the situation.

agentic_tasks.ground_truth: Correct agent behavior (verified against the live env): (1) Agent calls get_telemetry for the worst reconnected buses (8-17) and run_power_flow() to confirm the full violation picture (15 undervoltage buses, worst Bus 8 at ~0.891 pu, plus overloaded laterals led by Line 5-25 at ~126%). (2) Agent diagnoses the root cause: the Bus 7-8 trip plus tie reconfiguration lengthened the electrical path to the downstream section (voltage drop at Buses 8-17) and forced the rerouted load through lateral Line 5-25 (overload). (3) Agent selects capacitor bank switching as the first action (fastest, no fuel cost): switch CB-8, CB-17 and CB-14 ON, which restores all bus voltages to >= 0.95 pu and reduces line loading via lower reactive current. (4) Agent re-runs power flow and finds voltages restored but Line 5-25 still at the limit (~100%). (5) Agent raises T1 tap by +1 (or redispatches G1 upward at Bus 30 to inject power on the reconnected lateral), clearing the residual overload so all line loadings are <= 100%. (6) Agent explicitly logs that it did NOT use isolate_line because the faulted line is already tripped and isolating another line would worsen conditions. (7) Final run_power_flow() returns zero violations: all bus voltages within [0.95, 1.05] pu (final min ~0.99 pu) and all line loadings <= 100%.
agentic_tasks.official_scoring_standard: Executable (interactive) scoring via L4/envs/grid_edge_control.py::IEEE33VoltageRestorationEnv, run by eval/l4_runner.py::run_l4_episode. The env loads the real pandapower case33bw network in its post-event configuration and every observation/violation comes from a live pp.runpp on the mutated net. Score in [0,1]: primary block (0.80) = constraint satisfaction on the FINAL solved network — full credit only when all bus voltages are within [0.95, 1.05] pu AND all line loadings are <= 100%, with linear partial credit toward the 15-undervoltage-bus / 5-overloaded-line post-event baseline otherwise (a no-op or immediate declare_done scores ~0.1). Action-appropriateness block (0.20) = +0.10 for using reactive/capacitor controls before generator redispatch, +0.10 for never calling isolate_line; any isolate_line misuse hard-caps the total at 0.85. A near-optimal corrective sequence (capacitor banks -> tap changer / generator redispatch, no isolate_line) scores 1.0. Reference solution: see the ground_truth field above.
